component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
' Rows: 0 at 100..300, 1 at 340..540, 2 at 580..780 (outside the 2-row window). Guides: green 300 (row 0 ' bottom), yellow 500 (2 x rowHeight), cyan 540 (window without the trailing spacing), magenta 580 (with it). ' Shots: "rest" (focus on row 0), "row1" (focus moved to the bottom row without scrolling). sub init() m.seq = 0 root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for r = 0 to 3 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") for c = 0 to 7 item = row.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "R" + r.toStr() + "C" + c.toStr() end for end for m.rows = m.top.findNode("rows") m.rows.content = root m.rows.setFocus(true) m.steps = [{ op: "shot", name: "rest" }, { op: "key", key: "Down" }, { op: "shot", name: "row1" }, { op: "done" }] m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "runSteps") m.timer.duration = 2 m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub rec(phase as string, kase as string, body as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = m.seq.toStr() while len(s) < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + kase + "|" + body end sub
sub runSteps() if m.steps.count() = 0 then return s = m.steps.shift() if s.op = "shot" rec("await", "shot", "name=" + s.name) m.timer.duration = 4 m.timer.control = "start" else if s.op = "key" rec("await", s.key, "rowItemFocused=" + m.rows.rowItemFocused[0].toStr()) m.timer.duration = 2 m.timer.control = "start" else if s.op = "done" rec("done", "end", "rowItemFocused=" + m.rows.rowItemFocused[0].toStr()) m.top.probeExit = true end if end sub
